title: Play a song on YouTube

steps.instruction: Tap the search icon, the magnifying glass at the top right.
Tap the search button on the keyboard.
Tap play if it does not start by itself.

source_note: YouTube for iPhone on iOS 26/27, English. Assumes YouTube is installed, setup is complete and internet access is available. Search position, keyboard label, result ordering and playback may vary; ads may appear. Steps 2 to 6 need a phone check. Documentation review only; not checked on a phone. Source: https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/111997?hl=en&co=GENIE.Platform%3DiOS
